title: Kantan Module Configuration
description:
JSON schema for a kantan module YAML configuration entry. Each module is defined either inline in config.yaml under 'modules:' or as a standalone file in modules.d/. This schema describes the structure of a single module definition.

Environment variables available to command-type plugins:
  - KANTAN_SETTINGS: JSON string of the module's 'settings:' block (plugin-defined structure)
  - KANTAN_APPEARANCE: "dark" or "light" (current system appearance)
  - KANTAN_PID: Kantan's process ID (e.g. to tie child processes to kantan's lifetime)
  - KANTAN_MODULE_NAME: The module's 'name' field from config
All four are given to the 'command', 'watch' and 'toggle' commands and to commands run from the module's views; KANTAN_SETTINGS is unset when there are no settings.

name.description: Unique identifier for this module. Used for CLI triggers ('kantan trigger <name> refresh') and display purposes.

type.description: Module type. Determines which configuration factory is used and what 'config:' fields are available. Plugin authors use 'command' type.

placement.description: Where this module appears in the bar. Supports or-wise syntax for notch-aware fallback.

icon.description: Static icon displayed before the module's text. Accepts an icon name from the bundled font (e.g. "brain", "bolt-filled") which is resolved via the icon name map, or a literal Unicode glyph. The '-filled' suffix selects the filled variant. Can be overridden at runtime by the plugin's JSON output 'icon' field.

fonts.description: Per-module font overrides. Format for each: "FontName:Size" or "FontName:Weight:Size". Prefix with "system:" for system-installed fonts (default is bundled). Example: "system:Helvetica Neue:13".

style.description: Per-module style overrides for light and dark mode. Overrides the global style from config.yaml.

interaction.description: Hover and click behavior for this module.

iconPosition.description: The side of the module its icon is on, its text taking the other. Defaults to 'left', and to 'right' for a module at 'notchleft' whose hover reveals, so its icon stays beside the notch as the rest slides out.

anchor.description: For a module whose placement names 'center': on a display without a notch, 'icon' puts the module's icon on the bar's centre, the modules around the centre moving along with it. The module on the icon's side sits against it as its text does, the padding between the two giving way to 'iconTextSpacing', so the two read as one module. The first module to name an anchor is the one. Does nothing on a notched display.

transition.description: How the module enters and leaves the bar as it shows and hides: a module that hides under some condition, such as focus, waveform or a command whose output is hidden. 'slide' slides it to and from the edge its group is anchored to, which is the notch for 'notchleft' and 'notchright' and the screen's edge for 'left' and 'right'. 'none' shows and hides it at once. Defaults to 'slide' beside the notch and 'none' elsewhere. Reduce Motion turns it off.

mask.description: Position this module over a native macOS menu bar item, effectively replacing it visually. Clicks reach the native item underneath (passthrough) unless interaction.click sets a type.

displays.description: Control which displays this module appears on. Accepts 'main', 'all', or an array of display names. When omitted, the module inherits the global 'displays' setting (which defaults to 'main').

config.description: Module-type-specific configuration. The structure depends on the 'type' field. Required for 'text', 'clock' and 'command'; optional for the rest, whose fields all have defaults.

PlacementSpec.description:
Placement specification. Single values position the module on a specific side. Or-wise syntax (e.g. "right|notchright") selects placement based on whether the display has a notch.

On a notched display, the placements correspond to:
  |← left →|← notchleft|[NOTCH]|notchright →|← right →|

On a display without a notch:
  |← left →|← notchleft|center|notchright →|← right →|

Behavior per placement:
  - left: left side, grows rightward. Always visible.
  - right: right side, grows leftward. Always visible.
  - notchleft: adjacent to notch in left ear, grows leftward. Hidden on non-notch displays.
  - notchright: adjacent to notch in right ear, grows rightward. Hidden on non-notch displays.
  - center: centred in the bar. Hidden on notched displays.
  - right|notchright: notchright on notched displays, right on others.
  - left|notchleft: notchleft on notched displays, left on others.
  - notchleft|center: notchleft on notched displays. On others, ends at the bar's centre, left of any center modules, and grows leftward.
  - notchright|center: notchright on notched displays. On others, starts at the bar's centre, right of any center modules, and grows rightward.
  While only one of those two sides has a module showing and none is at center, its modules are centred in the bar together.

Color.description: A hex colour (e.g. "#FF3B30" or "FF3B30") or a theme template (e.g. "{theme(red)}"), resolved against the active theme palette for the current appearance.

Icon.description: An icon: a glyph name of kantan's bundled icon fonts (e.g. "bell" or "bell-filled"), or any text to draw in its place.

StyleConfig.description: Light/dark mode style configuration. Can be specified as nested light/dark objects, or as a flat StyleModeConfig that applies to both modes.

oneOf.description: Flat style applied to both light and dark modes.

StyleModeConfig.description: Per-appearance-mode style. Colours are hex strings or theme templates (see Color).

fg.description: Foreground color — applies to both icon and text unless overridden by 'text' or 'icon'.

bg.description: Background color for the module's shape.

shape.description: Module background shape. 'pill' = fully rounded, 'box' = square corners, 'underline'/'overline' = bottom/top border only.

InteractionConfig.description: Interaction configuration for hover and click behavior.

HoverConfig.description: Hover interaction: what the module does while the pointer is over it.

type.description: Hover type. 'tooltip' shows a floating panel near the module. 'reveal' keeps part of the module hidden until the pointer is over it, when it slides out from the edge the module's group is anchored to. Defaults to 'tooltip' when omitted.

reveal.description: For a 'reveal' hover, the parts hidden until the pointer is over the module: 'icon', 'text', or a list of them. Left out, they are the parts the module's output marks (a plugin's 'reveal' and its segments' 'reveal'), and the text when the output says nothing of them.

persist.description: For a 'reveal' hover, whether what it reveals stays while the module's menu or popup is open.

content.description: Text content for the tooltip. Defaults to '{value}'. Supports {value}, {icon} and the module's template variables (e.g. a plugin's 'variables' or the focus module's {mode}).

view.description: View DSL tree for rich tooltip content. See plugin-output.schema.json for the ViewNode schema. When 'view' is present, it takes priority over 'content'.

ClickConfig.description: Click interaction. Defines what happens when the user clicks the module.

type.description: 'menu' shows a dropdown menu (native or themed). 'popup' shows a themed SwiftUI panel. Both update while open, each time the module does. 'toggle' runs the module's toggle command and triggers a refresh. 'complete' runs the module's toggle command and triggers a refresh (identical to 'toggle'). 'passthrough' and 'drawer' are set internally for masked and drawer modules respectively. Defaults to 'menu' when omitted.

view.description: View DSL tree for menu/popup content. See plugin-output.schema.json for the ViewNode schema. When omitted, the module's runtime view tree (from plugin JSON output) is used.

MaskConfig.description: Position this module over a native macOS menu bar item. The module visually replaces the native item while allowing click-through to the original.

index.description: Zero-based index of the native menu bar item (from the right) to mask.

name.description: Name of the native menu bar item to mask: a system item's Control Centre identifier or alias, or, with Accessibility permission, a third-party app's bundle identifier, name or executable name (e.g. 'rift', 'com.1password.1password'). Known system values: Clock, Battery, WiFi, Bluetooth, Volume, Focus, ControlCenter, UserSwitcher, NowPlaying, Display, ScreenMirroring, Camera, Microphone. Aliases: Volume→Sound, Focus→FocusModes, ControlCenter→BentoBox-0, Camera/Microphone→AudioVideoModule. Raw plist identifiers (e.g. 'Sound', 'FocusModes') also work directly. Named items are matched ignoring case.

StateStyle.description: Per-state style override (power states, Focus modes), taking priority over the module style while its state applies. Accepts a colour string shorthand (applied as fg) or an object with fg/bg/icon.fg/text.fg.

oneOf.description: Colour applied as the foreground colour.

CommandConfig.title: Command Module Config
CommandConfig.description: Configuration for 'command' type modules (used by plugins). The command is executed periodically or on-demand, and its stdout is parsed as the module's display value.

command.description: Shell command or executable path to run. A command starting with ./ or ../ runs from the config directory. Run with the launcher (default /bin/sh -c) and given KANTAN_SETTINGS, KANTAN_APPEARANCE, KANTAN_MODULE_NAME and KANTAN_PID. Stdout, trimmed of surrounding newlines, is the module's value; a non-zero exit or timeout shows nothing.

output.description: 'text' treats stdout as the display value. 'json' parses stdout as a JSON object (see plugin-output.schema.json); output that isn't a JSON object, or an object without a string 'value', is shown as plain text.

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds: the command is re-executed every 'interval' seconds, skipping a poll while it is still running. 0 disables the timer, so the command runs only at startup, on wake and space changes, and on 'kantan trigger <name> refresh'. Ignored when 'watch' is set.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before the command is terminated.

watch.description: Long-lived watcher process command, run with /bin/sh -c and given KANTAN_MODULE_NAME, KANTAN_SETTINGS, KANTAN_APPEARANCE and KANTAN_PID. Disables polling. With output: json, each stdout line that is a JSON object becomes the module's output; alternatively the watcher runs 'kantan trigger <module_name> refresh' to re-run 'command'. Its stdin is a pipe that reaches EOF when kantan stops it or exits; a second later, SIGTERM is sent to it and everything it started. Stopped on sleep, started on wake, relaunched on appearance changes; when it exits it is restarted after 1s doubling to 16s, giving up after 10 consecutive restarts (a run of 30s or more resets the count).

toggle.description: Command executed with the launcher when the module is clicked with click type 'toggle' or 'complete'; the module refreshes once it exits. Receives the same environment variables as 'command'. Not resolved against the config directory.

settings.description: Plugin-specific settings. This object is serialized to JSON and passed to the plugin via the KANTAN_SETTINGS environment variable, with {theme(name)} templates resolved for the current appearance. The structure is otherwise plugin-defined.

launcher.description: Override the shell used to execute 'command' and 'toggle' (not 'watch'). Defaults to /bin/sh -c.

path.description: Path to the shell or interpreter.

args.description: Arguments passed before the command string.

ClockConfig.title: Clock Module Config
ClockConfig.description: Configuration for the built-in clock module.

format.description: Date/time format string using Unicode Date Format Patterns (e.g. "HH:mm", "EEE d MMM HH:mm"), plus 'do' for the day of the month with its English ordinal suffix.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London"). Defaults to the system timezone when omitted or unrecognised.

formats.description: Variable name to format string. Each is exposed as a template variable holding the current time in that format (e.g. {"date": "E MMM do"} gives {date} = "Mon Nov 16th").

PowerConfig.title: Power/Battery Module Config
PowerConfig.description: Configuration for the built-in battery module. Uses nested 'icons' block. Supports per-state style overrides via 'style' sub-block.

lowThreshold.description: Battery percentage below which the 'low' style is applied.

charging.description: Icon shown when charging. Defaults to 'bolt-filled'.

plugged.description: Icon shown when on AC power but not charging. Defaults to 'plug'.

level.description: Icons for battery levels (empty to full), split evenly across 0-100%. Defaults to battery-filled, battery-1-filled ... battery-4-filled.

style.description: Per-state style overrides, in priority order charging, plugged, lowPowerMode, low. Each can be a colour string (applied as fg) or an object with fg/bg/icon.fg/text.fg.

plugged.description: Style when on AC power and not charging.

lowPowerMode.description: Style when Low Power Mode is active on battery.

low.description: Style when on battery below lowThreshold.

VolumeConfig.title: Volume Module Config
VolumeConfig.description: Configuration for the built-in volume module. Icon-only display (no text). Uses nested 'icons' block.

level.description: Icons for volume levels (low to high), split evenly across 0-100%. Defaults to ["volume-4", "volume-2", "volume"].

muted.description: Icon shown when muted. Defaults to 'volume-off'.

device.description: Device-specific icon overrides. Keys are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the CoreAudio device name. Defaults to {"AirPods": "device-airpods", "Headphones": "headphones"}; setting it replaces the defaults, and {} disables device icons. The muted icon takes precedence.

WiFiConfig.title: WiFi Module Config
WiFiConfig.description: Configuration for the built-in WiFi module. Icon-only display (no text). Uses nested 'icons' block.

strength.description: Icons for signal strength levels (weak to strong), split evenly across -90 to -30 dBm. Defaults to ["wifi-1", "wifi-2", "wifi"].

disconnected.description: Icon shown when disconnected. Defaults to 'wifi-off'.

hotspot.description: Icon shown in place of the signal-strength icons while connected to a personal hotspot, such as an iPhone's. Defaults to 'circles-relation'.

BluetoothConfig.title: Bluetooth Module Config
BluetoothConfig.description: Configuration for the built-in Bluetooth module. Icon-only display (no text). The icon is dimmed while Bluetooth is off or no devices are connected. The module-level 'icon' has no effect.

icon.description: Icon shown when Bluetooth is enabled. Defaults to 'bluetooth'.

disabledIcon.description: Icon shown when Bluetooth is disabled. Defaults to 'bluetooth-off'.

WorkspaceConfig.title: Workspace Module Config
WorkspaceConfig.description: Configuration for the built-in workspace/spaces module.

type.description: Workspace manager type. 'native' uses macOS native spaces (event-driven via NSWorkspace notifications). 'aerospace' uses the Aerospace tiling window manager (trigger-driven via CLI). 'rift' uses the Rift tiling window manager (event-driven via a subscription through the rift-cli beside the running rift).

icons.description: Ordered list of icons for workspaces, by the provider's 0-based index (native spaces count across all displays, including hidden full-screen spaces). Workspaces beyond the array length fall back to the module-level 'icon' field, then the workspace's label.

rainbow.description: Per-workspace colours. Applied only when enabled with a non-empty 'colors', and not with the native appearance.

random.description: When true, colours are assigned in a deterministic random order avoiding adjacent repeats. When false, colours map index-wise, cycling.

max.description: Workspaces per page. With more, the page holding the active workspace is shown, with indicators for hidden pages.

icon.description: Overflow indicator icon or text. Can be false (disable), a string (same icon for both directions), or an object with 'left' and 'right' keys. Defaults to '‹' and '›'.

style.description: Style for overflow indicators. Only 'fg' is used, a hex colour or {theme(name)} template; without it, or with a template the palette can't resolve, indicators take the inactive colour.

scrolling.description: Rift only. While the active workspace uses Rift's scrolling layout and has windows, shows its windows in strip order instead of the workspaces, with the selected one highlighted.

icons.description: App name or bundle identifier to icon, matched ignoring case; the bundle identifier is tried first.

workspaces.description: Show a column of pips for the workspaces with windows beside the windows.

rainbow.description: Colours each app's windows from a palette.

colors.description: Palette for window colours. Defaults to the module's rainbow.colors.

DrawerConfig.title: Drawer Module Config
DrawerConfig.description: Configuration for drawer modules. A drawer hides/shows adjacent modules in the same placement group. For right-to-left placements (right, notchleft), the drawer controls modules listed before it in config. For left-to-right placements (left, notchright), it controls modules listed after it. There is one drawer per side (left/notchleft, right/notchright); the first configured on a side is the one that toggles.

show.description: Icon shown when drawer content is hidden (click to show).

hide.description: Icon shown when drawer content is visible (click to hide).

value.description: Static text to display. Must be a string; quote values YAML would read as a number or boolean.

IconConfig.title: Icon Module Config
IconConfig.description: Configuration for icon-only modules. The icon is set via the top-level 'icon' field. This config block is typically empty or omitted.

FocusConfig.title: Focus Module Config
FocusConfig.description: Configuration for the Focus mode indicator module. With Full Disk Access, reads the active Focus mode from the Do Not Disturb database; otherwise detects the system Focus menu bar indicator (live with Accessibility permission), which reports presence only. The module is hidden when no Focus mode is active and otherwise shows the module icon (default 'brain') unless overridden per mode. Exposes the {mode} template variable. Polls every 2 seconds.

icons.description: Focus mode → icon overrides. Keys match a mode's name (e.g. 'Do Not Disturb') or identifier (e.g. 'com.apple.donotdisturb.mode.default'). Unmatched modes use the module icon.

style.description: Focus mode → style overrides, keyed like 'icons'. Each can be a colour string (applied as fg) or an object with fg/bg/icon.fg/text.fg. Unmatched modes use the module style.

WaveformConfig.title: Waveform Module Config
WaveformConfig.description: Configuration for the waveform module, which draws the sound the Mac is playing, from any app, in the colour of the module's icon. Hidden while there is no sound unless 'hide' is 'never'. A click of type 'toggle' brings the app making the sound to the front. Exposes the {state} template variable ('Playing' or 'Silent').

style.description: What is drawn: 'bars' for the level of each band of frequencies, lowest first, or 'wave' for the sound's wave as a line.

bars.description: How many bars the 'bars' style draws.

width.description: Width of the 'wave' style's line in points.

hide.description: When the module leaves the bar: 'silent' while there is no sound, or 'never'.

sources.description: Whose sound is drawn. 'apps' is the apps in the Dock and the helpers that play for them, such as a browser's, leaving out the system's own sounds, a notification's among them, and apps that live in the menu bar alone. 'all' is every sound the Mac plays.

exclude.description: Apps whose sound isn't drawn, by name (such as 'Spotify') or bundle identifier (such as 'com.spotify.client'), in any case.

sensitivity.description: How much taller than measured the sound is drawn, up to the module's height: 1 as it is, 2 twice as tall. Left out, it follows the number of bars drawn, as each bar of a wider waveform holds less of the sound: 1 up to 8 bars, and a quarter more for each doubling past that (1.5 at 32 bars, 2 at 128). The 'wave' style draws at 1.

matchWidth.description: The name of a module whose width this one follows, such as a now-playing module on the other side of the notch: the waveform draws as many bars, or as wide a wave, as fit that module's width, growing and shrinking with it. 'bars' and 'width' are then the least it draws, and what it draws while that module is out of the bar or isn't in the config.

silenceDelay.description: How long the output stays quiet, in seconds, before the module counts it silent. 0 follows the sound as it stops, hiding the module the moment playback pauses, and at any gap within the sound too.

rainbow.description: Colours the bars from a palette, as the workspace module's rainbow colours its workspaces. Needs 'enabled' and a non-empty 'colors'. Not applied with the native appearance.

random.description: Shuffles the colours, the same way each time and with no two alike side by side. When false, the bars take the colours in the order listed, going round again past the last.

colors.description: The palette: hex colours or {theme(name)} templates.

gradient.description: Colours the bars from 'low' to 'high': the lowest frequency's bar is 'low', the highest's 'high', and those between pass from one to the other. With 'colors', they pass through each of those in turn instead. Comes before 'rainbow'. Not applied with the native appearance.

colors.description: Two or more colours the bars pass through, from the lowest frequency's to the highest's. Comes before 'low' and 'high'.
